finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker could provide a filePath that includes shell metacharacters, leading to OS command execution.
finding.assumptions: The filePath is derived from untrusted input, and the environment where this code runs allows shell metacharacters to be interpreted.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: An attacker could provide a query string that includes regex metacharacters, leading to unexpected behavior or denial of service.
finding.assumptions: The query is derived from untrusted input, and the regex library used does not properly sanitize input.
